name: @arraypress/text
description: Text utilities — truncation, CSV escaping, HTML escaping, fuzzy-match normalisation and typo-tolerant search. first lines (slugify moved to @arraypress/slug)

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.js && npm run duplication
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && diff -r -x '*.js' .types src && rm -rf .types

author: David Sherlock
